ROBOTIS DynamixelSDK C++ source, pinned to
`f838bc90f72fcf5b9c279432d6e12fc24969daa8` (upstream `ROBOTIS-GIT/DynamixelSDK`).
Only the `c++/include/dynamixel_sdk` and `c++/src/dynamixel_sdk` trees are
included. The unmodified upstream license is in `LICENSE`.

The Robot native arm library compiles the Linux C++ SDK sources into its own
shared object. It does not install libraries or headers into the Jetson system.
